name: Megan Foster
tagline: Precision operations, inventory optimization, and vendor procurement built for high-velocity supply chains.
summary: I am a Supply Chain Management student at the University of South Florida (USF) combining four years of founder-level small business operations with high-volume inventory replenishment and event logistics.

At Teeny Theenys Boutique, I directed domestic and global procurement of specialty fabrics, managed nearly 200 apparel SKUs, and maintained a 100% on-time fulfillment rate across 3-week custom lead times. My background bridges hands-on warehouse cycle counting and par-level enforcement with formal quantitative training in supply network modeling, linear programming, and ERP workflows.

projects.title: Teeny Theenys Boutique — E-Commerce Supply Chain
projects.description: Founded and scaled an e-commerce apparel business. Directed domestic and international fabric procurement, managed production of 40 custom units monthly, maintained strict cycle counts across 200 SKUs, and eliminated order slippage across 3-week lead times.

projects.title: Stolis — High-Volume Inventory & Replenishment
projects.description: Controlled par levels and beverage inventory in a high-velocity service venue. Analyzed consumption velocity to forecast weekly replenishment orders, enforced strict First-In First-Out rotation on perishable stock, and reconciled daily POS ledgers.

projects.title: Ameristar — Banquet Staging & Event Logistics
projects.description: Synchronized floor staging and material flow between back-of-house storage and dining ballrooms for 500+ attendee galas. Audited Banquet Event Orders (BEOs) and par requisitions to prevent shortages and service bottlenecks.

projects.title: USF Operations Modeling & Optimization Projects
projects.description: Conducted case studies in supply network design, EOQ safety stock calculations, demand forecasting, linear optimization modeling, and procurement strategy at USF Muma College of Business.

experience.description: Directed complete supply chain lifecycle from international fabric procurement to finished-goods distribution. Led a 3-person team maintaining 100% on-time delivery across nearly 200 SKUs.
Managed high-volume par levels and weekly stock replenishment. Enforced FIFO rotation standards to eliminate spoilage and reconciled daily POS transactional ledgers.
Staged event equipment, table settings, and back-of-house material supply for 500+ attendee corporate galas. Audited BEO requisitions to prevent inventory shortages.
